registers.name: CTRL_ENABLE
registers.description: Global enable for transport and safety operation. Bit 0 gates outbound request issuance, response acceptance, and actuator command updates. Other bits read as 0.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: 1 enables request/response transport and safety-controlled actuator update path; 0 forces deterministic safe fallback behavior.

registers.name: SAFE_CMD_LO
registers.description: Safe fallback actuator command, low byte.

fields.name: SAFE_CMD_LO
fields.description: Bits [7:0] of the 16-bit deterministic safe fallback actuator command.

registers.name: SAFE_CMD_HI
registers.description: Safe fallback actuator command, high byte.

fields.name: SAFE_CMD_HI
fields.description: Bits [15:8] of the 16-bit deterministic safe fallback actuator command.

registers.name: CMD_MIN_LO
registers.description: Minimum actuator command clamp, low byte.

fields.name: CMD_MIN_LO
fields.description: Bits [7:0] of the 16-bit minimum actuator command clamp.

registers.name: CMD_MIN_HI
registers.description: Minimum actuator command clamp, high byte.

fields.name: CMD_MIN_HI
fields.description: Bits [15:8] of the 16-bit minimum actuator command clamp.

registers.name: CMD_MAX_LO
registers.description: Maximum actuator command clamp, low byte.

fields.name: CMD_MAX_LO
fields.description: Bits [7:0] of the 16-bit maximum actuator command clamp.

registers.name: CMD_MAX_HI
registers.description: Maximum actuator command clamp, high byte.

fields.name: CMD_MAX_HI
fields.description: Bits [15:8] of the 16-bit maximum actuator command clamp.

registers.name: RATE_LIMIT_EN
registers.description: Rate-limit enable.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: 1 enables step limiting relative to the prior accepted actuator command; 0 disables rate limiting.

registers.name: RATE_LIMIT_STEP_LO
registers.description: Rate-limit step magnitude, low byte.

fields.name: STEP_LO
fields.description: Bits [7:0] of the 16-bit maximum permitted per-update step magnitude.

registers.name: RATE_LIMIT_STEP_HI
registers.description: Rate-limit step magnitude, high byte.

fields.name: STEP_HI
fields.description: Bits [15:8] of the 16-bit maximum permitted per-update step magnitude.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD_LO
registers.description: Watchdog timeout threshold, low byte.

fields.name: THRESH_LO
fields.description: Bits [7:0] of the 16-bit response timeout threshold.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD_HI
registers.description: Watchdog timeout threshold, high byte.

fields.name: THRESH_HI
fields.description: Bits [15:8] of the 16-bit response timeout threshold.

registers.name: STALE_THRESHOLD_LO
registers.description: Stale-data age threshold, low byte.

fields.name: THRESH_LO
fields.description: Bits [7:0] of the 16-bit stale-data rejection threshold.

registers.name: STALE_THRESHOLD_HI
registers.description: Stale-data age threshold, high byte.

fields.name: THRESH_HI
fields.description: Bits [15:8] of the 16-bit stale-data rejection threshold.

registers.name: STATUS_FLAGS_LO
registers.description: Latched status flags, low byte.

fields.name: REQUEST_ISSUED
fields.description: Sticky indication that at least one outbound request packet has been issued since reset.

fields.name: RESPONSE_RECEIVED
fields.description: Sticky indication that at least one inbound response packet has been received since reset.

fields.name: CLAMP_OCCURRED
fields.description: Sticky indication that an accepted command was clamped to the configured min/max range.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_OCCURRED
fields.description: Sticky indication that the watchdog timeout threshold was exceeded.

fields.name: STALE_DROPPED
fields.description: Sticky indication that a stale response was observed and ignored.

fields.name: DUPLICATE_DROPPED
fields.description: Sticky indication that a duplicate response was observed and ignored.

fields.name: OOO_DROPPED
fields.description: Sticky indication that an out-of-order response was observed and ignored.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ENGAGED
fields.description: Sticky indication that the deterministic safe fallback command is active or was selected due to timeout, disable, or fault.

registers.name: STATUS_FLAGS_HI
registers.description: Latched status flags, high byte. Reserved for future compact status extension and reads as 0 in the current contract.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved. Reads as 0.

registers.name: FAULT_COUNTERS_0
registers.description: Fault/event counters byte 0, least-significant byte of the 32-bit counter bundle.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE0
fields.description: Fault/event counter bits [7:0].

registers.name: FAULT_COUNTERS_1
registers.description: Fault/event counters byte 1.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE1
fields.description: Fault/event counter bits [15:8].

registers.name: FAULT_COUNTERS_2
registers.description: Fault/event counters byte 2.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE2
fields.description: Fault/event counter bits [23:16].

registers.name: FAULT_COUNTERS_3
registers.description: Fault/event counters byte 3, most-significant byte of the 32-bit counter bundle.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE3
fields.description: Fault/event counter bits [31:24].

registers.name: DEBUG_COUNTERS_0
registers.description: Debug counters byte 0, least-significant byte of the 32-bit debug bundle.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE0
fields.description: Debug counter bits [7:0].

registers.name: DEBUG_COUNTERS_1
registers.description: Debug counters byte 1.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE1
fields.description: Debug counter bits [15:8].

registers.name: DEBUG_COUNTERS_2
registers.description: Debug counters byte 2.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE2
fields.description: Debug counter bits [23:16].

registers.name: DEBUG_COUNTERS_3
registers.description: Debug counters byte 3, most-significant byte of the 32-bit debug bundle.

fields.name: COUNTER_BYTE3
fields.description: Debug counter bits [31:24].

init_sequence: Assert rst_n low, then release synchronously on clk.
Program SAFE_CMD via SAFE_CMD_LO/SAFE_CMD_HI to the conservative fallback actuator command.
Program CMD_MIN via CMD_MIN_LO/CMD_MIN_HI and CMD_MAX via CMD_MAX_LO/CMD_MAX_HI so the allowed command window is valid and bounded.
Program RATE_LIMIT_STEP via RATE_LIMIT_STEP_LO/RATE_LIMIT_STEP_HI and set RATE_LIMIT_EN as needed.
Set CTRL_ENABLE.ENABLE to 1 only after all limits and fallback values are configured.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS_FLAGS_LO/STATUS_FLAGS_HI to detect request issuance, response reception, clamp events, timeout events, stale/duplicate/out-of-order drops, and fallback engagement.
Read FAULT_COUNTERS_0 through FAULT_COUNTERS_3 to obtain the 32-bit fault/event count bundle.
Read DEBUG_COUNTERS_0 through DEBUG_COUNTERS_3 to obtain the 32-bit debug count bundle.
Optionally read CTRL_ENABLE, SAFE_CMD, clamp, rate-limit, timeout, and stale threshold registers to confirm runtime configuration.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map uses a custom byte-wide control bus because the spec implies an 8-bit address and 32-bit data control window rather than AXI/APB.
Multi-byte values wider than the 8-bit data bus are split into byte registers with explicit little-endian byte ordering.
No new hierarchy, ports, or bus protocols are invented beyond the DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON contract.
